message:
Per #482: apply review notes for markdown parsing

## Summary
This PR applies the final regex adjustment that was already agreed in ticket #482 and the follow-up review thread on the markdown parsing cleanup.

## Context
In the discussion on #482, the conclusion was to keep the parser behavior aligned with the existing `label(proto:value)` handling and avoid the extra character restriction in the trailing capture group. The current branch still contains the interim version from earlier review iterations.

This change is just the mechanical follow-up to that sign-off / LGTM and brings `get_markdown()` in line with the approved pattern.

## What changed
- updates the `get_markdown()` regex so the value segment uses the standard non-greedy `([\s\S]*?)` capture
- removes the bracket-specific restriction from the final capture group

## Why
Per the notes on #482, this parser path should accept the full value payload consistently rather than applying a narrower character class only to the final segment. This keeps the implementation aligned with the reviewed behavior and avoids carrying forward the temporary mismatch.

## Review guidance
This PR is intended only to apply the already-approved regex tweak from #482. Re-evaluating the parsing approach itself is out of scope here; the goal is simply to match the prior decision and close out the remaining review note.
